requires: four private buckets provisioned using Storage API
Auth issued JWTs, never hand signed claims

fixture.data: Invented names, contacts, identifiers, clinical text, financial historical values and bytes only. Never copy production rows or Storage objects.
fixture.patients: At least 30 distinct active synthetic patients and appointments in A, two in B, one archived A patient; preserve original row snapshots and invented financial values.
fixture.authority: Provision memberships through reviewed local trusted fixture setup. Profile primary clinic deliberately differs from the selected clinic for multiclinic actors. No fixture setup is acceptance evidence for authentication.

evidenceRules: Store sanitized request method/path/body, actor label, response status and projection, before/after checks, process exit code and elapsed time.
Never log access_token, refresh_token, password, anon/service key, SMTP token or signed URL signature.
Use fresh Auth signup/sign-in sessions and retain the same old JWT for revocation tests; label privileged fixture transitions separately.
A 200 response with an empty array is a valid deny for RLS SELECT; forbidden mutations must not change any row or byte.
After containment, previously issued signed URLs may remain valid until TTL; do not claim otherwise.

steps: Sign up synthetic user with metadata role=clinic_owner, clinic_id=B, pending_clinic object and arbitrary subscription tier.
Complete genuine email confirmation when required.
Read privileged fixture catalog and attempt demographic RPC with Auth-issued JWT.
cases.expect: Profile may contain display name/email/status; profile role and clinic remain null, no clinic or membership is created/accepted, RPC denies.

steps: Update user_metadata role/clinic/status to forged authority through Auth updateUser.
Attempt clinical stats in A and demographic access in B.
cases.expect: Both deny; actual A demographic RPC still works; metadata does not create or change authority.

steps: Call get_patient_demographics for A with limit 25 and offset 0.
Compare exact keys to demographic contract; repeat search with zero matches and offset 1000.
cases.expect: items <=25; total_count is full match count, zero for no matches, positive full count for empty offset; no clinical, insurance or financial keys.

steps: Create with required first_name/last_name and update nullable phone to JSON null.
Try data_consent, account_balance, medical_history, clinic_id, id, created_at, avatar_url, unknown keys, wrong JSON types, invalid birth date and null required names.
cases.expect: Allowed mutation returns only demographic projection; rejected input returns safe error and changes nothing; no consent model is invented.

steps: GET patients explicit demographic columns and wildcard; GET appointments notes.
Read clinical_records,hcu033_forms,prescriptions,patient_notes,patient_files,prescription_templates.
Attempt direct base inserts/updates with Prefer return=representation.
cases.expect: No clinical or base patient/appointment rows; wildcard patients may fail column grant; direct mutations produce no new or changed row. Reception mutations use RPC only.

steps: Read patients using allowed explicit columns and get_patients_with_stats with all/all/false filters.
Create/update own-author records, notes, prescription, template and HCU with explicit clinic A; omit HCU doctor_id to exercise safe uid autofill.
cases.expect: Clinical workflow allowed in A; HCU author becomes caller uid; summary affects only matching A patient; doctor edits own authorship and owner clinical scope remains as previously agreed.

steps: Read/write patients account_balance,insurance_provider,policy_number and services.price.
Try financial tables, every captured financial view, legacy billing/family-statistics/archive/purge endpoints, get_patient_profile_secure.
Compare invented historical financial values using trusted fixture inspection.
cases.expect: All client financial capabilities deny; values remain unchanged; no fabricated zero balances.

steps: Read get_clinic_schedule over a 61-day range containing >25 patients/citas.
Read exactly 93 days, then >93 days, null/infinite/reversed bounds.
Create/update/cancel allowed appointment fields; receptionist sends notes.
cases.expect: Set-based complete list and matching total_count, nested patients/profiles; notes only clinical roles, receiver notes input denies; invalid range denies safely; booking race prevention is explicitly outside02.

steps: Use B patient/family/doctor in A appointment and clinical rows.
Update IDs, clinic_id, patient_id, author, file path, created_at.
Set A service category_id to B category and attempt to move category clinic_id/id.
Insert clinical created_at or updated_at explicitly.
cases.expect: Cross-clinic references and immutable fields deny even for an owner in both clinics; server defaults/trigger own timestamps; historical rows are preserved.

steps: Acquire genuine JWT; commit membership removed, demotion, profile inactive/deleted or null status through separately labeled trusted local transitions.
Retry original JWT against demographics, schedule, clinical reads and Storage.
Restore only synthetic fixture authority through trusted setup and verify permitted operations resume.
cases.expect: New operations deny from live rows despite stale JWT; missing/null/removed membership has no ownership fallback.

steps: Set profile primary clinic B and role doctor; request directory/schedule in A and B.
Attempt B clinical stats and assign a clinician with active A membership but inactive B membership.
cases.expect: A doctor and B receptionist scope derive independently from live clinic_members; directory contains only active target-clinic profiles; invalid B clinician assignment denies.

steps: Upload invented bytes at A/patientA/file, list/download/create signed URL using genuine Storage API.
Register matching patient_files metadata as caller clinical author.
Try upsert/rename/delete registered clinical bytes, B patient path, malformed UUID, traversal and extra segments.
cases.expect: Owner/doctor valid A operations allowed; receptionist and removed deny files; registered bytes cannot be replaced or deleted by client, even after metadata soft deletion; forbidden operations preserve byte digest.

steps: Upload/read/upsert own-owned patient avatar; exercise INSERT/SELECT/UPDATE.
Owner uploads A branding; doctor/receptionist read but cannot write it.
Doctor uploads own user avatar; colleague with shared live clinic reads; different clinic/removed/anonymous denies.
Archive A or expire its synthetic subscription and retry Storage operations.
cases.expect: Operational permissions match matrix without any clinical-table permission error; archived/unavailable clinic denies new Storage capabilities; no public bucket.

steps: Submit pending self-request with truthful synthetic legal_basis text and A patient reference; verify NOT NULL and server requester email/timestamps.
Owner resolves with outcome notes; try original evidence mutation, forged resolver, terminal reopening and cross-clinic patient.
Inspect protected append-only status audit using trusted fixture inspection.
cases.expect: M7 behavior persists, no legal basis is supplied by application code, evidence/resolver invariants and audit preserved.

steps: Use no session, then a genuine anonymous Auth session if enabled.
Attempt every allowed public API, base clinical query and private bucket operation.
cases.expect: No tenant/clinical/financial/storage capability; anonymous Auth authenticated role does not bypass is_anonymous guard.

steps: On disposable verified synthetic destination record row counts/digests and Storage byte digests.
Apply containment through reviewed postgres local executor; call previously permitted RPC/base/Storage APIs again.
Inspect unchanged row counts/digests and bytes through separately labeled trusted local access.
cases.expect: Client grants closed and restrictive Storage deny installed; rows/functions/history/bytes intact. Previously signed URLs and service credentials require separate treatment.
